snippet.title: Jack O' Kazam's Spooktacular Halloween
snippet.description:
Jack O' Kazam is back in Toontown, but this is no normal Halloween! From October 25th to October 31st, you'll be able to find Jack O' Kazam in Toontown Central, offering a limited time Trick or Treat ToonTask.

Clarabelle's Cattlelog is also carrying the exclusive "Spooky Purple" Toon Color, only available to purchase during the Spooktown event. 

Learn more and play for FREE at:
https://www.toontownrewritten.com/
